warnings: These are generic TYPE sections keyed only to a symbolic span 'L' (never a printed number) — this sheet gives no position/grid_ref for any beam mark, only its cross-section spec. No plan view in this house's drawing set assigns these marks to grid segments (see หน้า18/_scope.json) — positions could not be joined; recorded as spec-only per §7, awaiting a beam plan that does not exist in this scan.

Several marks (B2, B3, B4, B6) print TWO sections along the span (SECTION_1-1 near a support at L/5-L/4, SECTION_2-2 at midspan) with different top/bottom bar counts — standard continuous-beam curtailment (extra top steel at supports, extra bottom steel at midspan). Per the project's established curtailment convention (§7, B3X precedent), the smaller/continuous count is recorded as main_bar.top or .bottom and the curtailed extra bars are folded into that same face's note rather than invented as a separate zone field, since this schema has no 'per-zone' rebar concept.
B1 and B10A print only ONE section (no L/5 zone), meaning uniform reinforcement along the whole length — no curtailment note needed for those two.
